tasks.name: Replace Scrub Daddy sponge
tasks.notes: Replace sooner if torn, crumbly or smelly. Sanitise weekly: dishwasher top rack, or damp in the microwave max 60 s. No bleach. Sources: https://support.scrubdaddy.com ; https://www.scrubdaddy.ph/pages/faq
tasks.history: New task. Scrub Daddy gives no fixed lifespan (depends on use; rough surfaces/harsh chemicals wear it faster) - replace sooner if torn, crumbly or smelly. Every 2 months matches their claim that FlexTexture foam is lab-tested not to hold odours for up to 8 weeks. Between replacements: rinse under warm water after use and let it dry; sanitise in the dishwasher TOP rack, or dampen and microwave for no more than 60 s. No bleach. Old one can be retired to bathroom/outdoor jobs. Sources: https://support.scrubdaddy.com/support/solutions/articles/156000293551-how-long-do-your-scrubbers-last- ; https://support.scrubdaddy.com/support/solutions/articles/156000293558-is-scrub-daddy-top-rack-dishwasher-safe- ; https://www.scrubdaddy.ph/pages/faq (8-week odour claim, microwave 60 s, no bleach) ; https://scrubdaddy.net.au/faqs/ Last done back-calculated so the first due date lands on a quiet weekend.

tasks.name: Check fire extinguisher (gauge in green, pin & seal intact, accessible)
tasks.notes: In place & unobstructed, pin + seal intact, no damage/rust, gauge in green; replace if used or >10 yrs. Fire blanket: accessible, replace if used or >7 yrs. Source: https://www.fireproductsdirect.ie/our-guide-to-maintaining-fire-safety-equipment-in-your-home/
tasks.history: New task. Monthly user check: in its place and unobstructed; pin and tamper seal intact; no damage, rust or leaks; gauge needle in the green (if not, get it serviced/replaced); replace after any use or if >10 years old. No legal requirement for a professional service at home. Fire blanket (if you have one, ideally in the kitchen): at the same time glance that it is accessible and the case/tapes are intact; inspect properly yearly and replace if used, damaged or >7 years old. Sources: Fire Products Direct (IE) home guide https://www.fireproductsdirect.ie/our-guide-to-maintaining-fire-safety-equipment-in-your-home/ ; IS 291 monthly user checks https://www.fireproductsdirect.ie/resources/how-to-use-a-fire-extinguisher/ ; HSA extinguisher checks https://www.hsa.ie/media/riop52fh/103525-hsa-2-fire-extinguisher-data-sheet.pdf ; Longford Co.
